notes: Single source of truth for what a PM must connect. The setup skill reads this file. Probes are read-only and tiny. claude.ai connectors load at session start, so a PM who connects one mid-session must restart Claude Code before the probe can pass.

connectors.name: Arali
connectors.why: Customer calls, emails, WhatsApp, and Freshdesk ticket reads (Arali ingests Freshdesk).
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Arali > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.why: Read decisions and threads; deliver updates and release notes after approval.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Slack > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.why: Read dealer and stakeholder threads; draft release notes and updates.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Gmail > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.why: Read PRDs, docs and the goals sheet.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Google Drive > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.why: Plan the week around real meetings; find decision meetings.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Google Calendar > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

connectors.name: Google Sheets
connectors.why: Read and write status on each PM's quarterly goals sheet. Drive alone cannot write cells.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Google Sheets > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

probe.search: google sheets spreadsheet read range values
probe.call: the cheapest read tool found, against the PM's goals sheet

connectors.name: Atlassian (Jira + Confluence)
connectors.why: Read sprint and ticket movement for plans and updates; file PRD stories; read Confluence docs.
connectors.connect: claude.ai > Settings > Connectors > Atlassian > Connect. Then quit and reopen Claude Code.

probe.search: jira confluence atlassian accessible resources user
probe.call: the cheapest read tool found, e.g. current user or accessible resources

connectors.name: ClickHouse
connectors.why: All metrics. Every PM uses their own ClickHouse Cloud user; the OS never stores credentials.
connectors.connect: Claude does this with you; no terminal. 1) Ask data/eng in Slack for a read-only ClickHouse Cloud user. 2) Claude opens ~/.pm-os/clickhouse.env in TextEdit; paste CLICKHOUSE_USER and CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD after the = signs, save, close. 3) Claude registers it and asks you to restart Claude Code.

probe.setup: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/secret-file.sh clickhouse.env CLICKHOUSE_USER CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD; then bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/secret-status.sh clickhouse.env CLICKHOUSE_USER CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD; then bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/add-clickhouse.sh

connectors.name: Freshdesk (write)
connectors.why: Post internal notes on tickets. Reads come through Arali. Public replies are drafted, never posted by the OS.
connectors.connect: Claude does this with you; no terminal. 1) In Freshdesk, click your profile picture, then Profile settings, then copy Your API key. 2) Claude opens ~/.pm-os/secrets.env in TextEdit; paste it after FRESHDESK_API_KEY=, save, close. 3) Claude checks the key is yours.

probe.setup: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/secret-file.sh secrets.env FRESHDESK_API_KEY FRESHDESK_DOMAIN; then bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/secret-status.sh secrets.env FRESHDESK_API_KEY

connectors.name: Spyne Blue Brain
connectors.why: Code knowledge graph, so PRDs match how the code works today.
connectors.connect: Enabled org-wide; if missing, ask the claude.ai org admin.

connectors.name: GitHub CLI
connectors.why: Contributing: /pm-os:capture opens a PR that the intake Action merges automatically. Also prompt and code history for change detection.
connectors.connect: Claude does this with you; no terminal. If the GitHub CLI is missing, Claude installs it. Then Claude starts sign-in and shows you a one-time code: open github.com/login/device in your browser and enter it. You also need to be added to the Product14/pm-os repo.
